name: Motorcycle Simulator Oklahoma
summary:
Ride Oklahoma City from the seat - alone or with your friends.

35 KM ROUND OKLAHOMA CITY
I-40 west through the Crosstown past Bricktown and the Paycom Center, under the Skydance Bridge with the Devon Tower rising over Scissortail Park. The Will Rogers Expressway (I-44) runs up the west side past State Fair Park and east past Penn Square, then I-35 heads south past Remington Park with the State Capitol dome off to your right.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist
